tests.description: Normalizes explicit bahia-contextvm-v1 relay set from a trusted service author.
Verifies missing or untrusted ContextVM relay sets fall back to browser relays with degraded metadata.
Verifies encrypted ContextVM transport prefers contextvm_relays when present and still requires explicit encrypted capability advertisement.
Injects EVENT, EOSE, and auth-required CLOSED callbacks through the pool harness with no sleeps or timeout-as-completion assertions.
